tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Self-introspection: resolve the caller's identity + entitlement + granted scopes. Returns {subject, type, active, plan, scopes, export_cap}. Works when the account has no active plan (active:false), so an agent can check access before it calls a data tool.

tools.name: search_awards
tools.description: Search awarded tenders in one country (Postgres), largest amount first, stable paging. Every filter is a property of this schema; country omitted means singapore. A bad value or an unknown argument is an invalid-params error whose data lists every problem (errors[]). Returns {rows, total, page, page

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: All awards for one supplier (by display-name match).

tools.name: get_agency
tools.description: All awards for one agency (by slug or display-name match).

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export a filtered award set as CSV, at most 500 rows per call (use the REST /api/v1/awards.csv for larger files). country omitted means singapore. A bad country is an error, not a Singapore file.

tools.name: get_buyer
tools.description: Buyer (agency) detail by slug: summary stats, yearly spend trend, sector breakdown, and top suppliers.

tools.name: get_buyer_detail
tools.description: Alias of get_buyer (back-compat). Buyer (agency) detail by slug: summary stats, yearly spend trend, sector breakdown, and top suppliers.

tools.name: get_supplier_detail
tools.description: Supplier detail by slug: summary stats, yearly awarded trend, sector breakdown, and top buyers.

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Single tender (award) detail by numeric award_id OR public tender page id, with related awards (same tender / same buyer).

tools.name: get_sector
tools.description: Sector detail by slug: summary stats, yearly trend, and active partners (kind=buyers|suppliers).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Faceted full-text search over one collection (scope). Every filter is a property of this schema, the same params as REST GET /api/v1/search; values of a fixed list are matched in any case. A bad value or an unknown argument is an invalid-params error whose data lists every problem (errors[]). Tender

tools.name: list_buyers
tools.description: Top buyers (agencies) by total spend.

tools.name: list_suppliers
tools.description: Top suppliers by total awarded.

tools.name: list_sectors
tools.description: The curated sector taxonomy (slug + name).

tools.name: get_lists
tools.description: List every saved award list the caller (x-api-key owner) can see. Each list has itemCount (tender items only), buyerCount, supplierCount and totalCount (all items). Requires a user API key.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a new saved award list (personal). Body: name. Requires a user API key.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: One saved list with paginated items joined to award data (description/buyer/supplier/amount/date). Requires a user API key.

tools.name: rename_list
tools.description: Rename a saved list. Body: id, name. Requires a user API key (creator or workspace owner).

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Delete a saved list (and its items). Body: id. Requires a user API key (creator or workspace owner).

tools.name: add_to_list
tools.description: Add a tender to a saved list. Body: id (list id) + tender_no OR award_id. Idempotent. Requires a user API key.

tools.name: remove_from_list
tools.description: Remove a tender from a saved list. Body: id (list id) + tender_no. Requires a user API key.

tools.name: get_saved_searches
tools.description: List every saved search the caller (x-api-key owner) can see (personal + shared workspace). Requires a user API key.

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: Save a search under a name. Body: name, query (filter set), kind? ('atlas' → unified-search shape, else legacy Explorer filters). Requires a user API key.

tools.name: get_saved_search
tools.description: One saved search by id (visible to the caller, else not_found). Requires a user API key.

tools.name: rename_saved_search
tools.description: Rename a saved search. Body: id, name. Requires a user API key (creator or workspace owner).

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Delete a saved search. Body: id. Requires a user API key (creator or workspace owner).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "whoami" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Self-introspection: resolve the caller's identity + entitlement + granted scopes. Returns {subject, type, active, plan, scopes, export_cap}. Works even when inactive (active:false) so an agent can verify auth and decide whether to pay before doing work." → after: "Self-introspection: resolve the caller's identity + entitlement + granted scopes. Returns {subject, type, active, plan, scopes, export_cap}. Works when the account has no active plan (active:false), so an agent can check access before it calls a data tool."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
